title: The Fast Fourier Transform in Fourier Spectroscopy
lineage: July 1966 Goddard report credits Cooley and Tukey, describes use of Cooley’s FORTRAN IV program, and reports implementation in the IRIS experiment data-reduction and simulation programs. Exact implementation date and flight use are not established.
